summary: Verified removal of 'College / University' and 'Student ID Number' fields from the Student Discount form in the Financial Aid modal on /programs. Submitted a full student application end-to-end (POST /api/financial-aid returned 200, success step rendered). Regression on Scholarship and Custom Discount flows confirms the two fields are absent there too, and Custom still shows the 'Discount %' input. The italic verification note remains visible on the Student form.
critical_code_review_comments: FinancialAidModal.jsx still keeps `institution` and `student_id` in form state and sends them as empty strings in the POST body. Backend accepts them as Optional[str] so it works, but consider removing these keys from the payload and state to keep the API contract clean.
seed_data_creation: Submitted one financial-aid application via Brevo email (test_student_<timestamp>@example.com) — real email is sent per existing behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Student Discount form now contains only: Full Name, Email, Phone, Instagram, Program of Interest, Situation textarea, and italic verification note. data-testids aid-institution-input and aid-studentid-input are removed from DOM. Custom Discount still renders aid-discount-input. Scholarship has no extra inputs beyond the common ones. POST /api/financial-aid works for all three aid types and returns {success:true,message:'Application received. Check your email for confirmation.'}.
